What is the trace (sum of the principal diagonal elements) of the matrix $(X - Y)$?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A box contains $9$ slips bearing numbers $-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4$ and $5$. An experiment consists of drawing a slip from this box and replacing it back in the box after noting the number. This experiment is repeated $9$ times. These $9$ numbers are now chosen as elements of a $3 \times 3$ matrix, then the probability that the matrix is skew symmetric is
questions.answerSource: Supplied QPT 7 HTML answer key · Q6
questions.solution: Skew-symmetric: diagonal $0$, $a_{ji}=-a_{ij}$; 7 choices for each of 3 pairs, so $\frac{7^3}{9^9}$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text:
Let $A$ be a $3 \times 3$ matrix. A matrix $B$ is obtained from $A$ by applying the following sequence of elementary row operations in order:

1. $R_2 \rightarrow R_2 - 2R_1$
2. $R_3 \rightarrow R_3 + R_2$
3. $R_1 \rightarrow R_1 + 3R_3$

If $B = P A$, where $P$ is a $3 \times 3$ matrix, then what is the sum of all the elements of the matrix $P$?
questions.answerSource: Supplied QPT 7 HTML answer key · Q7
questions.solution: $P=E_3E_2E_1$; the sum of all its entries is $0$.

questions.text:
Consider the following system of linear equations:

$x - y + z = 4$

$2x + y - 3z = 0$

$x + y + z = 2$

This system is represented in matrix form as $A X = B$ and is solved using the matrix inversion method, where the solution is given by $X = A^{-1}B$. Let $A^{-1} = \frac{1}{\Delta} C$, where $C$ is the adjoint matrix of $A$ and $\Delta = |A|$.

If the sum of the principal diagonal elements of matrix $C$ is $k$, and the solution to the system is $(x, y, z)$, then what is the value of the expression $k - \Delta + x + y + z$?

questions.text:
Let the determinant $\Delta$ be given by:

$$\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & \sin \theta & 1 - \sin \theta \\ 1 & \sin \theta - 1 & -\sin \theta & 1 \end{vmatrix}$$

where $\theta \in [0, 2\pi]$. Let $M_{ij}$ and $C_{ij}$ denote the minor and cofactor of the element $a_{ij}$ respectively.

A function $f(\theta)$ is defined as:

$f(\theta) = (a_{11}M_{11} - a_{12}M_{12} + a_{13}M_{13}) + (a_{31}C_{21} + a_{32}C_{2}$

What is the range of $f(\theta)$?
questions.answerSource: Supplied QPT 7 HTML answer key · Q14
questions.solution: The alien-cofactor part is $0$, so $f(\theta)=\Delta=2(1+\sin^2\theta)\in[2,4]$. (Key file gave no answer; solved independently.)
